extensions.name: Control Macro
extensions.description: Test fixture without MIDI: one command sets the first parameter of the first block to 50%.

extensions.name: MIDI Mapper
extensions.description: Map MIDI CCs and notes on one channel to block parameters and bypass. To learn a mapping, send a CC or note, then touch a control on the device.

extensions.name: MIDI Mapper
extensions.description: Sends MIDI CCs, notes and program changes on one channel to Mappings as triggers. Choose what each one does on the Mappings page.
